comments.author: @NikolaKnezevic-r5j
comments.text: It’s not as if I’m just guessing—I actually spent time in Sweden back in 1990–1991 (in Märsta, on Stjärngatan, right near Arlanda Airport)! So, I can speak with certainty, and my account definitely holds water... Swedes are a lively bunch—they know how to enjoy life and please both themselves and others! Swedish women are incredibly spirited, attractive, charismatic, alluring, hot, and erotic—women who are very hard to resist! Respect, Nikola Knezevic (born October 25, 1967, in Belgrade, Serbia; spent the last 12 years with my family—my 50-year-old wife and our 15-year-old daughter—seeking asylum in Metz, France, with our status still unresolved). We wish all Swedish men and women wonderful moments and the little things that give life meaning—making it even more beautiful than it already is!
